entries.label: Wed 25 Nov
entries.title: Balance Druid talents reworked, riding fixed for Paladins and Warlocks, plus pet and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Druid: Balance talents have changed. If you had 3 or more points in Improved Starfire, all your talent points have been reset, so spend them again before you play.
Druid: Improved Wrath is now Starlight Wrath. It also cuts Starfire's cast time by up to 0.5 seconds.
Druid: Improved Moonfire is now Moon and Stars. It also gives Starfire a 50 or 100% chance not to lose cast time when you're hit.
Druid: Improved Starfire now has 2 points, not 5, with an 8 or 15% chance to stun.
Druid: Eclipse now also raises Wrath's critical strike chance by 7, 13 or 20% at all times.
Druid: Moonfury is gone. Its replacement, Dreamstate, gives you 20 to 100% of Innervate's benefit when you cast Innervate on someone else.
Druid: Moonkin Form now also raises your Arcane and Nature damage by 10%.
Druid: Genesis now raises Hurricane's damage and Tranquility's healing, as it should. Hurricane's last hit now lands too.
Hunter: pets can now land critical strikes with their melee attacks. Until now they had no chance at all.

Hunter: for Beast Mastery, summoned Hawks now attack your target even when your pet is on Passive. They leave when you use Dismiss Pet, or when you right-click their icon under your portrait. They had about 5% less critical strike chance than intended. That is fixed.
Paladin: Exorcism can now land critical strikes. Judgements on enemies now refresh from your attacks once they drop below 20 seconds.
Paladin: the Libram of Law now adds to Judgement of Command's damage, as it should. For Holy, Oath of Light now lasts 60 minutes.
Rogue: Blizzard says poisons and Blinding Powder bind to you only for now, while it fixes a bug. That change went in on Tue 24 Nov: see below.
Rogue: Poised now ends when you use Sap or Distract in Stealth.
Shaman: Chain Lightning now uses up Clearcasting when you also have 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Warlock: pets can now land critical strikes with their melee attacks. The Succubus and Incubus had 5% more critical strike chance than intended. That is fixed.

blocks.heading: Riding
items: Paladin: "Justice and Retribution" (Forsaken) and "Judgment and Redemption" (Dwarf and Human) now teach you Journeyman Riding when you finish them.
Warlock: "Dreadsteed of Xoroth" now teaches you Journeyman Riding when you finish it.

Already finished the quest? Talk to one of these to learn Journeyman Riding for free: Danitha Morr in Bandarion Keep (Forsaken Paladins), Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind Cathedral (Alliance Paladins), Zevrost in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar (Horde Warlocks) or Ursula Deline in the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind (Alliance Warlocks).
This is the fix Blizzard promised on Mon 23 Nov. It first went in, without notes, on Tue 24 Nov: see below.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: Blackfathom Deeps: the Altar of the Deeps can be used again 3 seconds after someone uses it, and gives the Blessing of Blackfathom properly.
Sunken Temple: the Avatar of Hakkar no longer fails to appear.

blocks.heading: Monsters and spawns
items: Desolace: the centaurs in Magram Village respawn faster.
Duskwood: the Lost Knight no longer sometimes appears inside a tree.
Riverglades: Clubtoe in Sunnyglade no longer flags you for PvP.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: Mount Hyjal: on "Blind Vengeance", the Explosive Runeshard no longer makes the Felguard Sentinel's Mortal Strike hit far harder.
Searing Gorge: there are more Dark Iron Steamsmiths for "STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass".
Silithus: Encrypted Twilight Texts drop again for "Secret Communication", "True Believers" and "Still Believing".

Silithus: Blizzard says the repeatable Encrypted Twilight Texts quest for Cenarion Circle reputation is switched off on purpose. "Still Believing" still gives a chance of recipes, in a reward that comes by mail later.
Western Plaguelands: the Scarlet Illusion from "Scarlet Subterfuge" now lasts an hour, up from 30 minutes.
Hunter: the Horde version of "Saving the Best for Last" can now be finished.

blocks.heading: Items
items: The Night Watchman's Torch works while you're mounted or casting again. Blizzard says another fix had stopped that by mistake.
Unerring Purpose now sells to vendors for more than 2 copper.
The Blackblade of Shahram's haste buff now works, and only for the person wielding it.
Blackhand's Breadth can no longer be resisted, and Chained Essence of Eranikus no longer gets through immunities.
The Totem of the Storm is now called the Totem of the Maelstrom.

blocks.heading: Legacy
items: Finishing "Lord Valthalak Laid to Rest" now gives Legacy credit.
Reinforce now cuts the durability you lose by 8, 16, 24, 32 or 40%, as it should.
The Quick and the Dead now makes Shadowform, Moonkin Form, Travel Form and Trueshot Aura free too, as it should.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Enchanting: the Revelation weapon enchant now rolls its chance once per wave of an area spell, not once for every target hit. Its bonus also no longer lasts for the whole of a channelled spell.

blocks.heading: Not in Blizzard's list
items: Priest: ForeverChanges, a fan site, says Shadow Focus now also makes Mana Burn and Vampiric Embrace more likely to hit.
Rogue: ForeverChanges says the Legacy talent Reagent Economy now covers poisons and Vanish too, so they need no reagents from vendors. It first saw this at about 8:30pm UK time on Tue 24 Nov.

blocks.heading: Also
items: The fixes are dated Wed 25 Nov. Blizzard posted them at about 11:25pm UK time that day.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, on when Item Restoration will be switched back on, or on when you can look inside lockboxes again.

entries.label: Tue 24 Nov
entries.title: Paladin and Warlock epic mounts now teach Journeyman Riding, and Rogue poisons can no longer be sold

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Paladin: learning Summon Charger, or Summon Forsaken Charger, now also teaches you Journeyman Riding. Until now the quest didn't give it, so you couldn't ride other fast mounts. Blizzard listed the fix on Wed 25 Nov, with a free way to learn it if you'd already done the quest: see above.
Warlock: learning Summon Dreadsteed now also teaches you Journeyman Riding. It had the same bug, and gets the same free fix: see above.

Rogue: poisons and Blinding Powder now bind to you, so you can't trade them or sell them on the Auction House. Vendors no longer buy them either. Before, they showed a vendor price, but vendors wouldn't take them. Blizzard said on Wed 25 Nov that this is only for now, while it fixes a bug: see above.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard hasn't put these changes in its hotfix notes. Its newest list is still the one for Mon 23 Nov. ForeverChanges, a fan site, first saw them at about 8:30pm UK time on Tue 24 Nov.
The weekly maintenance was on Tue 24 Nov in the Americas and early on Wed 25 Nov in Europe. Blizzard Watch says nothing new is due to go live this week.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, on when Item Restoration will be switched back on, or on when you can look inside lockboxes again.

entries.label: Mon 23 Nov
entries.title: World buffs last through loading screens again, plus class, cooking and quest fixes

blocks.heading: World buffs
items: World buffs no longer fall off when you change area. Since about Sat 21 Nov, they had vanished at every loading screen, such as after a hearthstone, a portal or a boat.
So Warchief's Blessing, Might of Stormwind and the Dire Maul buffs last into dungeons and onto the other continent again. They still end when you enter a raid.
Fengus' Ferocity, one of the Dire Maul buffs, gave twice the spell power intended. That is fixed.
Darkmoon Faire buffs gave twice the power intended. That is fixed too.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Druid: the 4-piece Feralheart set bonus now gives 4 Energy every second for 5 seconds, as it should.
Priest: Mind Vision no longer sets off other effects.
Priest: for Shadow, Dark Inspiration now gives the right Spirit bonus when Mind Flay sets it off. Chastise now works in Shadowform.
Warlock: for Destruction, Intensity now works on Incinerate.
Warrior: some Warriors had Mortal Strike in their spellbook without the talent, and could use it. It stays in the spellbook, but now only works once you have spent the talent point.
A few spells and abilities set off weapon effects more often than intended. That is fixed.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: Uldaman: the Obsidian Sentinel drops its loot again, as intended. It had dropped no blue items since about Thu 19 Nov.
ForeverChanges, a fan site, says those blue items now sell to vendors for half as much as before. Blizzard hasn't listed that change.

blocks.heading: Items
items: The Filcher's Cowl no longer has a level requirement.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Cooking: Boiled Clams, Clam Chowder, Goblin Deviled Clams, Giant Clam Scorcho, Undermine Clam Chowder and Clam Linguine now give the right Well Fed bonus. They are now listed under Stamina Food.
Cooking: Murloc Fin Soup now restores more and gives a bigger Well Fed bonus, the same as the next tier of food.
Engineering: the Goblin and Gnome Engineer's Renewal Gifts no longer show as broken question marks in your bags.
Engineering: learning Goblin Mortar now teaches you The Mortar: Reloaded too, as it should.
Leatherworking: Pattern: Centaur Hoofwarmers can now be learned.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: Riverglades: on "Dunston Checks Out", Dunston Willis runs near the end of the escort again, as he should.
Wetlands: "For Further Study" now has rewards.
Wetlands: "Uncovering the Past" and "Gleaning Our Future" now give Ironforge reputation.

blocks.heading: Lockboxes
items: Blizzard says lockboxes opening straight into your bags is only for now. That change went in at about 6pm UK time on Sun 22 Nov.
A proper fix will let you look inside a lockbox and take only some of what's inside again. Blizzard hasn't said when.
Blizzard's Kaivax said this on the forums on Mon 23 Nov.

blocks.heading: Also
items: The fixes are dated Mon 23 Nov. Blizzard posted them at about 2am UK time on Tue 24 Nov.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Sun 22 Nov
entries.title: Lockboxes now open straight into your bags, and an Uldaman boss stopped dropping its blues

blocks.heading: Items
items: Lockboxes, junkboxes, sacks of gems and a few other containers now put what's inside straight into your bags when you open them. You can no longer look inside first.
Wowhead says this stops an exploit. What was inside a lockbox could change when it was mailed, so Rogues looked inside and mailed it on until it held something good.
Blizzard said on Mon 23 Nov that this is only for now: see above.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: Uldaman: from about Thu 19 Nov, the Obsidian Sentinel stopped dropping its blue items. Players had been farming it for gold. Blizzard fixed it on Mon 23 Nov: see above.
Wowhead said that also stopped you getting the Pendulum of Doom, a levelling axe that needs the Sentinel's Axe of Lingering Dread.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard hasn't put these changes in its hotfix notes. Its newest list is still the one for Fri 20 Nov.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Fri 20 Nov
entries.title: Dungeon resets cut to 5 an hour, plus group finder and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Rogue: Blade Flurry (Combat) now correctly makes Shank's damage hit one more target.
Warlock: Demonic Aegis (Demonology) could be locked into Demon Armor or Demon Skin and kept after you unlearned it. Unlearning your talents now removes it.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: You can now reset and enter each dungeon at most 5 times an hour, down from 10.
Blackrock Spire: a stone pillar should no longer trap players.

blocks.heading: Items
items: Stormshroud Armor: the 3-piece bonus now has a 3% chance on melee attacks to restore 18 Energy. It was a 4% chance to restore 30.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Summit of Eternity: Toron Rockhoof has repaired his forge and anvil. You can now use them for Blacksmithing and smelting.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: The Hinterlands: Witch Doctor Ti'ik now drops more than one copy of his head when a group on "Witch Doctor Ti'ik" kills him.
Feralas: Perfect Yeti Hide no longer drops again while you are on the quest it starts.
Tanaris: Gor'marok now respawns faster for "The Dunemaul Compound".
Riverglades: Dunston Willis no longer runs off partway through "Dunston Checks Out".

blocks.heading: Interface
items: Group finder: some players saw fewer groups than intended when looking for a group. That is fixed.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard posted these fixes around midnight UK time, at the end of Fri 20 Nov.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Thu 19 Nov
entries.title: The Seed Hybridizer is back, with a chance to fail, plus Cultivation and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Camping
items: Herbalism: the Seed Hybridizer works again.
Combining seeds in it now has adjusted values and a chance to fail. Blizzard hasn't given the numbers.
Scarce Herb Seeds can no longer go in the Seed Hybridizer.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Paladin: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization (Retribution) now correctly raises all the Holy damage you deal while you hold a two-handed weapon.

blocks.heading: Races
items: Tauren: Cultivation should now work more reliably on herbs you have the Herbalism skill for.
Tauren: Cultivation now works properly on Purple Lotus.
Skyborne: the 10% Honored discount now applies to Apprentice and Journeyman Riding from Genn Fairweather on Zephras Isle.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: City of Dalaran: the Shade of the Archmage no longer vanishes as soon as the fight starts. The Camp tab lists it as the source of the Arcane Salvager blueprint for enchanters.
The Shaper's Terrace: Vitrix's Poison Shock now does less damage.

blocks.heading: Monsters and spawns
items: Shimmering Flats: a Silithid Hive Drone near the Rustmaul Dig Site no longer gets stuck under the ground.
Riverglades: a bug stopped Mosh'gra's from ever dropping rare loot. That is fixed.

blocks.heading: Items
items: Motes of Unstable Magic are now soulbound, so they can no longer be traded or sold on the Auction House.
You can now delete a Squall-breaker's Potion.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: Booty Bay: after "Rift Away", Rix Xizzix no longer wrongly gives you access to a strange tome.
Alterac Mountains: on "Stormpike's Deciphering", you can now get a new Ensorcelled Parchment if you destroyed the first one.
"Hunting for Ectoplasm": the quest used the wrong type of creature for gathering ectoplasm. That is fixed.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard posted these fixes early on Fri 20 Nov, UK time.
The list still doesn't mention the 1 copper Auction House deposit or the two mail fixes.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Wed 18 Nov
entries.title: Auction House deposits now start at 1 copper, and Blizzard takes back exploit gold

blocks.heading: Auction House
items: Wowhead says the smallest deposit for a listing is now 1 copper, down from 1 silver. It came with this week's maintenance: Tue 17 Nov in the Americas and Wed 18 Nov in Europe.

The deposit still depends on the item's vendor price, how many you list and for how long. Listings that came to under 1 silver now cost less, mostly cheap items and short listings. The rest cost the same as before.
Blizzard has not put the change in its hotfix notes yet, though it said it would once the change was live.

Two mail fixes were due at the same time. Some mail has been arriving in about 2 minutes instead of the intended hour, and unread mail has shown "Stormwind Auction House" as the sender. Wowhead doesn't mention them, and Blizzard hasn't confirmed them yet.

blocks.heading: Gold
items: Blackmaw Hold: a room of non-elite monsters there was dropping full dungeon loot, as elites do. Blizzard fixed it early on Mon 16 Nov.

On Tue 17 Nov Blizzard said a couple of hundred players had farmed that room on purpose. It put an economy lock on their accounts, is taking back the gold they made, and is suspending the worst offenders.
If you ran the dungeon a few times and got extra loot, Blizzard says you did nothing wrong.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard has posted no new hotfix notes since the 17 Nov list.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Tue 17 Nov
entries.title: Upper Blackrock Spire back to full difficulty, plus camping, profession and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Camping
items: The Cozy Sleeping Bag now gives a Resting aura that shows when you are inside its area.
The Cozy Sleeping Bag can now be placed in specific spots, like hunter traps.
You can no longer sleep on the Cozy Sleeping Bag while mounted.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Might of Stormwind and Warchief's Blessing now always end when you die, as they should. They are no longer given to non-players.
Shaman: Flurry no longer wrongly loses stacks when Windfury Totem attacks land.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: Upper Blackrock Spire: its monsters had far less health and did far less damage than intended. That is fixed. Blizzard says it once again needs a full group of careful players.

blocks.heading: Monsters and spawns
items: Thousand Needles: Pesterhide Snarlers and Needles Cougars no longer spawn inside rocks, and Gravelsnout Diggers and Surveyors no longer walk into them.

blocks.heading: Items
items: Whiteout Staff and Crackling Staff now have the same stats: 25 Stamina, 25 Intellect and 74 spell power from weapon damage.
Escape Plan now has the right range and damage.
Paladin: Soulforge Armor, the upgraded dungeon set for tanks, now gives spell power instead of Strength. Blizzard says Paladin tanks will lean further on spell power as their main damage stat.
Priest: Shadow Priests can now hold a Night Watchman's Torch.

blocks.heading: Legacy
items: Reagent Economy should no longer stop working at random.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Some Waylaid Crate conversions gave an old turn-in item that is no longer used. If that happened to you, you can now hand those crates in for the right reward.

Blacksmithing: "The Old Ways" now gives the Orcish War Leggings recipe as an item. If you never got it, or lost it, Sumi in the nearby blacksmithing hut has a replacement once you have done the quest.
Blacksmithing: Bronze Mace is now bind on equip, so it can go in your transmog collection. Before, it never bound.
Blacksmithing: Craftsman's Writ: Golden Scale Gauntlets now tells you who to hand it in to.
Blacksmithing: a display bug with Master Swordsmith, Master Axesmith and Master Hammersmith is fixed.
Herbalism: Cultivation now works properly on Mageroyal.
Herbalism: the wildflowers for "Her World" no longer show on Find Herb unless you are on the quest.
Skinning: you can no longer skin a few creatures that are not meant to be skinnable.
Rogue: Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: Rogue: a bin of lost mail has turned up in the SI:7 quarters. Mathias Shaw can now give you the letter you need for "The Manor, Ravenholdt".
"Show Them How It's Done" now shows on your map.
Wetlands: there are more Fen Creepers for "Blisters on the Land".
"Step One: Rock": while you are on the quest, its rock piles now show with Find Minerals instead of Find Treasure.
"A New Ore Sample": there are more Gravelsnout Diggers and Surveyors. Blizzard's advice: take the ore sample, but do not take the candle.
The Battle for Alterac Valley quests now need level 58 to pick up.

blocks.heading: Shen'dralas
items: "Powering the Pylons": repairing a pylon now counts for nearby group members.
"Heart of Crystal": the Depleted Crystal Heart now drops for everyone in your group.
"Going Home": Rokren, the Gelkis you escort, now escapes more slowly.
Miners can now track Spectral Iron Ore, and it spawns more often.
Bristleback Skullcrushers and Decrepit Pylon Protectors use their abilities less often.
Summon Undead Ravager, cast by various necromancers, can now be interrupted.
"Agamaggan's Blood" is no longer a dungeon quest. You can now finish it in the elite area outside Razorfen Downs.

blocks.heading: Interface
items: Your ignore list now stays after you log out.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard posted these fixes early on Wed 18 Nov, UK time.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Mon 16 Nov
entries.title: Windfury Totem fixes, a better Fishing Rack, and dungeon and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Camping
items: The Fishing Rack now gives lures to everyone.
Bloated Fish from the Fishing Rack now turn up more often. Blizzard has adjusted what they contain to match.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Shaman: Windfury Totem's extra attacks are now reduced by armour, and there is now a cooldown between procs. Before, they ignored armour and had no cooldown.
Shaman: Windfury Totem's extra attacks now generate Rage.
Shaman: Mutilate and Execute no longer get an extra chance to trigger Windfury Totem. Shield Slam, Shield Bash and Shieldworn-empowered Holy Strikes can no longer trigger it at all.
Shaman: For Enhancement, the same Maelstrom Weapon stacks can no longer speed up two spells.
Shaman: For Enhancement, Thundering Strikes no longer needs a weapon equipped to give its critical strike chance.
Druid: Every rank of Wild Growth now goes on cooldown, as it should.
Druid: For Balance, the Genesis talent now raises the damage of Pounce's bleed.
Priest: Dark Inspiration no longer stacks when a group has more than one Shadow Priest.
Priest: Vampiric Embrace changes with the weekly maintenance. It will heal your group for 10% of your Shadow damage, down from 20%. You get twice that, so nothing changes when you play solo.
Rogue: Poisons can no longer go above their highest rank.
Rogue: Shank no longer wipes your combo points on other targets when you use it on a target without them. This happened even without the Boot Knife talent.
Warrior: The Revered Champion now offers Legacy of Valor to Warriors who qualify.

Warrior: For Fury, Cleave and Heroic Strike now trigger Unbridled Wrath and Reckless Swings, and no longer use up Flurry stacks. Reckless Swings has also been adjusted so the cooldown manager can track it.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: The Drowned City: Captain Dreadrise can now be stunned. The Abyssal Bubble he summons can no longer block, dodge or parry.
The Drowned City: the rare "Pyromancer" Braxton now reacts to combat instead of ignoring it.
Sunken Temple: the Atal'alarion serpent statues in the Pit of Refuse no longer stop working if you use them in the wrong order.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: The drop rate for "Blood Red Bandanas" is higher.
Rogue: On "The Talisman of Kazdor", Witch Doctor Zum'rah now spawns properly.
Twilight's Shroud: freeing the scout prisoners now counts for "No Soldier Left Behind" for your whole group.
Isle of Dread: for "Screecher Spirits", the Vale Screamers have moved to the coast.
"Water Pouch Bounty", a repeatable quest, no longer gives XP.
Theramore: a bug that could stop you finishing "The Return of the King?" is fixed.

blocks.heading: Items
items: Formula: Enchant Boots - Speed, a reputation reward, is now bind on pickup, as intended.
Outrider's Gloves now work properly.
The Violet Tragan no longer breaks crowd control effects.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard posted these fixes at 2:17am UK time on Tue 17 Nov.
The Auction House and mail changes are still due with the weekly maintenance on Wed 18 Nov in Europe, and on Tue 17 Nov in the Americas. Until then the smallest deposit is 1 silver for each listing.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Sun 15 Nov
entries.title: Dungeon XP rule eased: the cut-off is now a gap of more than 12 levels

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: Blizzard has eased Friday's dungeon XP rule. A kill now gives the group no XP only if someone in the group is more than 12 levels above that monster.
Under Friday's rule, a kill gave no XP if the monster was grey to anyone in the group. Blizzard says that missed the mark in dungeons where the monsters span a wide range of levels.
The change went live at about 1am UK time on Sun 15 Nov. Dungeon runs that had already started by then keep the old rule.

blocks.heading: The 9 Nov outage
items: If you paid a trainer between 9:17pm and 10:17pm UK time on Mon 9 Nov and lost that training in the outage, check your mail. Blizzard has sent you the gold it cost.
Blizzard posted this on Fri 13 Nov. The mail has already gone out.

blocks.heading: Also
items: The Auction House and mail changes are still due with the weekly maintenance on Wed 18 Nov in Europe, and on Tue 17 Nov in the Americas. Until then the smallest deposit is 1 silver for each listing.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on other progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Fri 13 Nov
entries.title: No dungeon XP if a monster is grey to anyone in your group, plus spawn and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: In dungeons, nobody in the group gets XP for a kill if the monster is grey (too low to give XP) to any member. So you get no XP from runs with a much higher-level player in the group. Blizzard eased this on Sun 15 Nov: see above.
The Drowned City: monsters other than bosses now respawn after 2 hours, up from 1 hour.
The Deadmines: Sneed now jumps out of Sneed's Shredder properly, even if it is stunned when it dies.
Pix Xizzix's weekly dungeon quests now leave your quest log at the weekly reset, as they should.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Shaman: Windfury Totem now triggers from all melee abilities, even ones that don't involve your main-hand weapon. The off-hand strike of abilities like Whirlwind or Mutilate can't trigger it, but their main-hand strike can.
Stuns between players and creatures now have diminishing returns, as intended. If a creature stuns you again and again, each stun gets shorter. The same goes for stuns you keep putting on a creature.
Druid: For Restoration, Wild Growth can no longer be cast while moving. It now gets twice as much from your healing power: 6.6%, up from 3.3%.
Mage: Damage from procs and from Blizzard now breaks Frost Nova, as it should.
Paladin: Judgement of Command now counts as a melee attack and can set off on-hit effects. All other Judgements are still ranged attacks.
Priest: The Legacy Perk The Quick and the Dead now lowers the mana cost of Divine Spirit, as it should.
Warlock: Siphon Life Rank 1 can no longer be cast while you are silenced.

blocks.heading: Monsters and spawns
items: Stranglethorn Vale: tigers, panthers and raptors now spawn more often.
Badlands: Lesser Rock Elementals now spawn more often.
Gnomeregan: Techbot now respawns faster for "Save Techbot's Brain!".
Mulgore: Quillboar and Venture Co. now spawn less often in the starting area.
Eastern Plaguelands and Stratholme: monsters should no longer attack you unexpectedly. This happened most often when you came back to life.
Blasted Lands: the Nethergarde Keep guards no longer drop loot.
Zephras Isle: Nyalah Brightfire in Valanaar now has a wider range of cooking supplies.

blocks.heading: Quests
items: These quest items now drop for everyone in your group who has the quest: Deadwood Key, Drop of Stolen Life, Ring of the Fallen Soldier, Venom-dripping heart and Blackthorne Intelligence.
"Coyote Huntin'": Sootfur's pelt is now shared with your whole group.
"A Quick Grocery Run": everyone can now read Skonk's list.
"Crate Expectations": the Unstable Package can no longer go off while you're on a flight path, and its misfire does less damage.
"Return to the Port": picking it up no longer deletes nearby players' items for "The Cook in the Cage".
Rogue: On "The Talisman of Kazdor", you no longer enter the wrong version of Zul'Farrak.
Mount Hyjal: the Crow Effigy now shows up when you meet the quest's requirements.

Riverglades: Jezap Jinglesprocket now offers quests to players working towards the Bloodmaster's Ring. "Gaseous Gold" now shows the right amount. Woodpiles can no longer be looted unless you're on their quests.
Feralas: several problems with "Gordunni Cobalt" are fixed.
Undercity and Stormwind: Owen Thadd and Garion Wendell accept books again.

blocks.heading: Items
items: Channeler's Ring now gives spell power instead of Spirit, and Blessed Band of Light no longer gives hit. Until the raids open, you can swap a Blessed Band of Light for a Channeler's Ring. The swap is the first item on Pix Xizzix's vendor list, and it can't be undone.
Taran Icebreaker now works as a two-handed mace, as intended.
The Glimmering Mithril Insignia trinket no longer needs you to be able to wear mail.
The Horde's Darkspear signet rings now give the same mana regeneration as the matching Alliance rings.
Stats are fixed on Everstaring Abomination Eye, The Bad Hat and The Souvenir Sea Shell.

blocks.heading: Fishing and the interface
items: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza: far more players on each ruleset can now win the weekly tournament. Blizzard is still working on the tournament's performance problems, with more fixes in the coming weeks.
If you have Secondary Talents, your action bar settings no longer reset every time you log out.

blocks.heading: Also
items: The Auction House and mail changes are still due with the weekly maintenance on Wed 18 Nov in Europe, and on Tue 17 Nov in the Americas. Until then the smallest deposit is 1 silver for each listing.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on restoring progress lost in the 9 Nov outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Thu 12 Nov
entries.title: Shaman changes go live, two days late

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Shaman: The Shaman changes in the 10 Nov hotfixes were held up. Blizzard says they went live in all regions at 6:45pm UK time on Thu 12 Nov. They have been moved here from the 10 Nov notes.
Shaman: You can now use a weapon imbue and a weapon totem at the same time. Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem can both trigger on your attacks.
Shaman: For Enhancement, Stormstrike now does 100% weapon damage, down from 150%. Its cooldown is 8 seconds, up from 6.
Shaman: For Enhancement, Mental Dexterity turns less Intellect into attack power. It is 33, 66 or 100% by rank, down from 50, 100 or 150%.

Shaman: For Enhancement, Maelstrom Weapon now cuts cast time and mana cost by 20% per stack at every rank. It triggers less often, 6 to 10 times a minute by rank instead of 20. Its tooltip shows your chance per swing, which depends on your main-hand weapon speed.
Shaman: Blizzard says this moves Enhancement back towards Windfury and away from Spell Power gear.

blocks.heading: Auction House
items: The Auction House changes are still not live, so the smallest deposit is still 1 silver for each listing.
In Europe they are due with the weekly maintenance on Wed 18 Nov, not 17 Nov as this page said before. The Americas get them on Tue 17 Nov.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, on restoring progress lost in Monday night's outage, or on when Item Restoration will be switched back on.

entries.label: Wed 11 Nov
entries.title: Auction House changes held back, plus class and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Auction House
items: Blizzard has taken the Auction House and mail changes out of the 10 Nov hotfixes, so they are not live yet. They have been taken out of the 10 Nov notes here too.
That means the smallest deposit is still 1 silver for each listing.
Blizzard says they will go live with the weekly maintenance on Wed 18 Nov in Europe, and on Tue 17 Nov in the Americas. They will then be listed again in the hotfix notes.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Shaman: If a totem went missing after Monday night's outage, Blizzard has now fixed it in all regions. The totem should be back in your bags.
Shaman: Flametongue Totem Rank 2 now works.
Druid: For Feral, Rend and Tear now works with Pounce Bleed.
Hunter: Volley no longer sets off proc effects. It also stops when you start moving.
Paladin: Judgement now counts as a ranged attack. It uses your ranged hit chance and no longer sets off melee effects.
Paladin: For Retribution, Unsealed Fury no longer echoes Windfury Totem attacks.
Priest: Gnomes can now use Confounding Flash in Shadowform. For Holy, Twilight Focus now works in Shadowform.

blocks.heading: Quests and world
items: Riverglades: Twilight Enforcers' Smash now does much less damage, and Executioner Morg hits less hard. The Twilight Forgemaster's Mark of Flames now adds 50 damage, down from 1,000.
Western Plaguelands: you can now use the Command Tent for "Scarlet Diversions".
Arathi Highlands: the Witherbark Mallet works again, so you can carry on with "The Giant in the Den".
Feralas: the cage door for "Freedom for All Creatures" now resets.
Shen'dralas: you can mount up again in its named areas.

blocks.heading: Items and professions
items: Bloody Claws of Attack now give the +1 weapon skill they should.
Earthen Silk Slippers no longer give more spell damage than intended.

Tailoring: five bags now need one more bolt of cloth. Red and Green Woolen Bags: 5 Bolts of Woolen Cloth, 10 slots. Green Silk Pack: 5 Bolts of Silk Cloth, 12 slots. Black Silk Pack: 6 Bolts of Silk Cloth, 12 slots. Red Mageweave Bag: 5 Bolts of Mageweave, 14 slots.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard has switched off the Item Restoration service for now while it fixes a serious bug.

After Wednesday morning's EU maintenance, some players saw "No realms are currently available" (WOW51900309). Blizzard support says this means you need the latest game update. Close the game, let the Battle.net app download the update, then start the game again.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, or on restoring other progress lost in Monday night's outage.

entries.label: Tue 10 Nov
entries.title: Class tuning is live, plus quest and profession fixes

blocks.heading: Classes
items: The class tuning Blizzard promised for Tue 10 Nov went live that day. The Shaman part was held up until Thu 12 Nov, so it is in that day's notes.
Hunter: Pet health is now 115% of normal, down from 150%. Hawk pets hit about 80% harder. Arcane Shot and Summon Hawk now cost 11% of your base mana at every rank.
Warlock: Your Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus and Succubus have about 15% more health. The Imp's first four Firebolt ranks hit harder.

Warlock: For Affliction, Wrack does 30% less damage and is now a 6-second channel. While you channel it, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast. Soul Siphon now boosts Drain Life, Drain Soul and Wrack for each of those spells on the target, up to 36%.
Shaman: Rage of the Storm, the Shaman quest reward, now gives 16 Strength instead of 16 Intellect. Its speed is now 3.6.
Druid: Omen of Clarity works again after you switch specs. For Restoration, Nature's Swiftness also makes Wild Growth instant.
Warrior: For Arms, Sweeping Strikes no longer uses up charges when there is no second target.

blocks.heading: Quests and world
items: Most quests from level 48 upwards now also give gold. Level 60 quests do not turn XP into gold.
Shatterspear Trolls no longer give XP.
Riverglades: many more Glade Vipers for "Poison Tips".
Duskwood: more Nightbane worgen for "Worgen in the Woods".
Murloc Tideskimmers now drop Saltwater Murloc Eyes for "A Taste of the Sea".
Feralas: you can start "Rescue OOX-22/FE!" again.
Zephras Isle: "Camping 101: Herbalism" now completes in Shen'dar Village.
The Broken Frond of Celastrus now drops for everyone in your group.
You no longer get sent to the wrong graveyard when you die.
The people of Pyrewood Village now appear at dawn and dusk as intended.
Racial mounts from vendors are now Bind on Pickup, so you can't buy them for another character.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Cooking: the Journeyman Campfire Kit now needs Cooking 90, down from 140.
Blacksmithing: Coarse Grinding Stones now give skill-ups up to 90, up from 75.
Alchemy: Minor Arcane Elixir sells to vendors for 5 copper, down from 25. Recipe: Elixir of Greater Firepower is now called Recipe: Elixir of Holy Power.
Enchanting: the Lesser Spirit enchants for boots and bracers now give Spirit. The Arcane Salvager now needs a Runed Golden Rod.
Engineering: Iron Grenades now cost 1 silver 25 copper from vendors, down from 5 silver.
Some crafted Bind on Pickup armour from Leatherworking, Tailoring and Blacksmithing now sells to vendors for less.
Fishing: Fishing Racks give lures more reliably. Blizzard knows about other rack problems, such as the "There is no loot" error.

blocks.heading: Also
items: For now, Blizzard is limiting new characters on the busier faction. That means Horde on North American PvP realms and Alliance on EU Roleplay-PvP realms.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, or on restoring progress lost in Monday night's outage.

entries.label: Mon 9 Nov
entries.title: Smaller crowds, easier dungeons and many quest fixes

blocks.heading: World
items: Blizzard lowered the number of players in zones that were very crowded. The change was bigger on PvP realms.
The flight from Camp Taurajo to Thunder Bluff no longer flies through objects.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Warlock: Finishing "Summon Felsteed" now teaches you riding. If you finished it earlier, summon your Felsteed once to get Apprentice Riding.
Druid: Feral Charge in Cat Form puts you in combat straight away. Natural Instinct now works with Lacerate and Pounce.
Hunter: You no longer pull far-away monsters just by targeting them.
Mage: Flamestrike's burning ground no longer uses up Clearcasting.
Priest: Casting Fear Ward no longer knocks you out of Shadowform.
Shaman: Lightning Overload now does the right Lightning Bolt damage.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: The Drowned City: monsters were hitting about 30% too hard. That is fixed.
Deathless Marrow: monsters have 25% less health. Some of their attacks are weaker or used less often.
Blackfathom Deeps: you can release your spirit after dying again.
Alcaz Prison: Zarla Ober now drops loot.
Waylaid Crates and Craftsman's Writs now drop inside dungeons.

blocks.heading: Monsters, quests and items
items: Un'Goro Crater: Young Diemetradons are now level 51 to 52, not 58.
Silverpine Forest: Ivar the Foul respawns at the right speed. Teldrassil: Ferocitas the Dream Eater spawns sooner.
Quest items for "The Monster Surfaces", "Croaky's Head" and "Elmpaw's Head" are now shared with your group.
Fixed: "Ever After", "Unwelcome Guests", "A Recipe for Death", "Fetch 'n' Fletch" and Jom-jom's escape.
"Feathers in Flight": you can loot the Hyjal Owl Nests before level 60.
Henrig Lonebrow's Journal respawns faster.
The Pouch of Violet Dust now gives the extra hour of Camp Benefits.
The Nifty Stopwatch no longer shares a cooldown with Sprint, Dash and Blink.

entries.label: Mon 9 Nov
entries.title: Emergency maintenance on Monday night

items: The servers went down for emergency maintenance at about 9:30pm UK time. They were back by about 10:45pm. Some players had to restart the game.
Players say some progress from just before the outage was lost. Spells they had trained and profession skill-ups were gone, but the gold they spent stayed spent. A few lost quest items.
Blizzard has not yet said whether anything will be restored. Check your spellbook and profession skill when you next log in, and retrain if you need to.

entries.label: Sun 8 Nov
entries.title: More XP from dungeon monsters

items: Monsters in dungeons now give 50% more XP. The change went live on Sunday evening.

entries.label: Fri 6 Nov
entries.title: Second round of hotfixes, and class tuning on the way

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Druid: Bloom now heals its target. Tooltips for Bear Form, Ravage and Swiftmend are corrected.
Mage: You no longer learn Research and lose it when you log out. Arcane Blast lasts 18 seconds.
Rogue: Shank tooltips now show the right rank and combo points.
Warlock: Your Voidwalker has about 40 more health. Soul Siphon no longer makes Wrack boost itself. Orc Command no longer over-boosts some pet abilities.
Warrior: The Reckless Swings tooltip now says it triggers Gore Drinker.
Quick and the Dead, a Legacy talent, now works every time.
Other players and their targets are easier to see from far away.

blocks.heading: Monsters and quests
items: Dun Morogh: troggs in Grol'bolar Quarry no longer respawn too fast.
Durotar: Ridgeshade Lurkers now drop loot.
Teldrassil: lashers are no longer immune to Nature damage.
"The Sleeper Has Awakened": Kerlonian falls asleep less, and you start with the Horn of Awakening.
"Never Saddle on Quality" has more spawns and drops. The Damp Note drops more often.
"Rediscovering the Light" lets you heal the NPCs again. "Vorsha the Lasher" no longer hits everyone in the zone.
Horde can pick up "Unending Torment" in the Ruins of Lordaeron at level 15, not 16.
Some Riverglades quest items are now shared with your group.

blocks.heading: Professions and dungeons
items: Leatherworking: the Tanning Rack now needs skill 125, down from 140.
Maraudon: Zaetar's Spirit appears after Princess Theradras. The Drowned City portal works again.

entries.label: Fri 6 Nov
entries.title: Fixes Blizzard said were coming

items: A proper fix for boats and zeppelins getting lost. Until it lands, temporary portals stand near the docks and zeppelin towers, and they'll be removed afterwards.
Population tuning for cities and other areas that feel emptier than intended.

entries.label: Thu 5 Nov
entries.title: First hotfixes

blocks.heading: Monsters and quests
items: Durotar: Yarrog Baneshadow respawns at the intended speed.
Dustwallow Marsh: some murlocs no longer respawn too quickly.
Swamp of Sorrows: Pelluk now spawns reliably.
Deathstalker Erland respawns much faster for "Escorting Erland".
Text fixed in "The Sisterhood of Elune".

blocks.heading: Zephras Isle and items
items: Lotheluum Starbreeze now trains Druids.
Trade supply vendors sell apprentice tradeskill bags.
Mild Spices sell to vendors for 1 copper.

blocks.heading: Also on 4 and 5 Nov
items: Invite-a-Friend players can chat, level past 10, join guilds and parties, and trade again. Log out and back in if you were affected.
If chat or other players look wrong, check your language and social settings, then log out and back in.
Battlegrounds: Plainsrunning no longer stacks, and stacks are cancelled when you carry a flag.
Launch-week Twitch drop: watch 4 hours of eligible WoW streams for the Pouch of Violet Dust, a toy that colours campfires.

entries.label: Wed 4 Nov
entries.title: Launch notes: what affects your play

blocks.heading: Questing and interface
items: Learning a spell no longer puts it on your action bars, and new bags no longer equip themselves.
Quest objectives have tooltips and map markers.
Quest XP was adjusted. Monsters respawn faster in low-level zones, fastest in starting zones, and Blizzard plans to slow low-level zones to more typical rates once the launch rush settles.
Ruins of Lordaeron quests need level 15. "Holy Diver" now gives XP, and "Carnage" is fixed.
Some satyrs now count as demons.
Class training for every rank from 1 to 60 costs about 206 gold in total.
Gamepad support works, but Blizzard still calls it a beta and is updating its interface.

blocks.heading: Combat
items: Every class deals more damage, and higher-level monsters have more health.

Low spell ranks no longer lose their chance to trigger talents. The exception is the Mage spell Blizzard: ranks learned more than 12 levels below you still trigger Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost less often.
Racials: Orc Command is back, Blood Fury has a 2-minute cooldown, Berserking lasts 15 seconds, Touch of the Grave can trigger every 15 seconds, and racial weapon specializations are gone.

blocks.heading: By class
byClass: Berserk is gone. The new Feral capstones are Primal Bite and Shifting Power. Bear threat is 115%, Shred does 200% weapon damage, and Starfire hits 40% harder.
Aimed Shot’s bonus damage is up about 110%, Sniper Shot’s 100%, and Arcane Shot’s base damage about 30%. All traps share a 30-second cooldown.
Critical Mass gives 6% for 3 points. Ice Lance does 300% more to frozen targets on an 8-second cooldown. Ice Barrier also raises Frost damage. Frost Blast is gone.
Righteous Fury comes at level 10. Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke and Blessing of Light are gone. The new capstones are Unsealed Wrath and Shieldsworn.
Holy Binding replaces Binding Heal. Shadow Word: Death backlash is 30%.
Shank arrives at 24 and Poised at 18. Poisons scale twice as much with attack power. Mutilate is the Assassination capstone and Death Mark the Subtlety one.
Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst. Top-rank Lightning Bolt hits 80% harder. Stormstrike does 150% weapon damage on a 6-second cooldown. Riptide is now a heal over time only.
Demons get 2 health per point of your Stamina, down from 7.5, so they're easier to lose. Wrack deals 86 damage a second at 60.
Defensive Stance threat is 80%. Slam has a 15-second cooldown. Reckless Swings and Improved Whirlwind are new talents.

blocks.heading: Known issues at launch
items: "No realms are currently available" (WOW51900309).
Faction locks, and some problems on the Roleplay and Roleplay PvP rulesets.

entries.label: Wed 9 Dec
entries.title: First raids open

blocks.note: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair for level 60 characters. The World tab counts down to it.
